issue_context.title: Vulkan: StandardMaterial3D doesn't have an `ensure_correct_normals` property like 3.x's SpatialMaterial did
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.dev (6d98f84ab)

### System information

Fedora 34, GeForce GTX 1080 (NVIDIA 465.31)

### Issue description

While investigating https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/49861, I noticed that StandardMaterial3D doesn't have a way to force the computation of normal scaling in real-time. This is useful when using non-uniformly scaled meshes, especially when their scale changes non-uniformly at run-time.

While this property has a performance cost, you don't always have an alternative since regenerating a mesh's normals is very costly to do at run-time on a complex mesh.

I think we should look into reimplementing it, or at least providing an add-on ShaderMaterial for it.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a StandardMaterial3D resource in the inspector and notice that there's no equivalent to `3.x` SpatialMaterial's **Ensure Correct Normals**.

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
